findings.description: The KMS key has no enable_key_rotation argument, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled (it defaults to false). This key protects audit data, and without rotation a single key version is used indefinitely, widening the exposure window if the key material is ever compromised and impeding the ability to cryptographically expire old ciphertext.
